text.description_html:
Mul-T-Lock 3/8" Diameter Shackle High Guard Security Padlock

The MUL-T-LOCK NE-Series heavy duty padlocks are designed to offer the highest level of padlock protection available in the market today. All NE-Series padlock shackles are made of Boron Alloy, and can withstand the most determined attempts of physical abuse. The High Guard shackle protector adds increased security for cutting attempts. When looking for the Ultimate in High Security Padlock Protection, MUL-T-LOCK'S NE-Series line of padlocks is your answer.

MUL-T-LOCK's high security locks are designed to provide superior door protection with uncompromised key control. The Key Card owner is the only person allowed to have the keys duplicated. Remove the worry about anyone making duplicates of your keys.

Supplied standard with 1 owner key card per key combination and 2 keys per lock cylinder.

Also available: Mul-T-Lock NE10LE1 3/8" Shackle Padlock

The shackle is locked with a double ball bearing mechanism. 90 degree key rotation unlocks the padlock.

Features for Mul-T-Lock NE10HE1 High Guard Security Padlock

  • 3/8" Diameter Hardened Boron Alloy Shackle
  • Hardened Steel Alloy Body
  • Drill and Pick Resistant Cylinder
  • Bump Proof Design
  • Mul-T-Lock 206SP Security Keyway
  • MUL-T-LOCK's Patented Interactive Key Control System
  • Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty

Specifications for Mul-T-Lock NE10HE1 High Guard Security Padlock

  • Shackle Diameter: 3/8" (10mm)
  • Total Height: 3-3/4" (95mm)
  • Total Width: 2-1/8" (54mm)
  • Total Thickness: 1" (25mm)
  • Clearance: 5/8" (16mm)
  • Standard Grades: "CEN" 5 ; "ASTM" 6
  • Supplied with 2 Keys per Lock

If ordering multiple locks you can have them Key Alike (use the same key) or Keyed Different (different keys for each lock). You can also order Extra Keys Cut below if more than the standard 2 keys are required.
